baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative construction at 85:17 words 2-4 binds arrival, report, and gathered force.
baseline_models.mechanism: The report is staged as motion toward the addressee: speech newly arises, crosses a threshold, and carries a gathered force into the listener's present. Hearing is therefore an encounter, not passive possession of information.

activation_trace.role: Literal coming and arrival supplies the report's motion into the addressee's present.
Speech arising as report supplies the transmissible event that performs the arrival.
A gathered mutually supporting force is what the arriving speech makes present as a collective rather than as isolated actors.

changed_reading.before: A question asks whether the addressee already knows information about armies.
changed_reading.after: The question makes the armies' report arrive as an encounter now, bringing their organized collectivity into the addressee's hearing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct 'report of the hosts' at 85:17 words 3-4 can make the hosts the object into which narration transforms them.
baseline_models.mechanism: A force exists by gathering helpers and projecting agency, but becoming a tale reverses that relation: the once-acting collective is now bounded, carried, and exemplified by another voice. The ruin-bearing reach of arrival makes that reversal latent even before any host is named.

activation_trace.role: The literal gathered force supplies the initial concentration of power that narration will reverse.
Becoming a tale people repeat turns the force from narrator of events into a narrated example.
Being overtaken by calamity or ruin supplies a possible reason a dominant force can arrive only as report.

changed_reading.before: The verse introduces a story whose subject is powerful armies.
changed_reading.after: The verse already intimates the armies' reversal: gathered powers have been reduced to the exemplary tale that now carries them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun at 85:17 word 4 retains both the ordinary gathered-force branch and a material branch of rough stony ground.
baseline_models.mechanism: The material branch permits the collective to be perceived as a hard field: massed units make a resistant surface as much as a roster of persons. Disclosure and the image of an approached road let the report function like entry into that field.

activation_trace.role: Rough stony ground supplies a material analogue for the hosts as a resistant collective field.
Disclosure or bringing out makes the report reveal the field's otherwise hidden organization.
A traveled approach, limit, or facing position supplies the listener's spatial entry toward that hard field.

changed_reading.before: The hosts are only a collection of military persons.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the hosts also register as hard organized terrain whose arrangement and resistance the arriving report exposes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier promised time gives the perfect-form arrival a forward vector. The hosts' already-arrived report can operate as an advance sign: a bounded past event carries an anticipated condition toward the listener.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival anchors the report's movement across temporal as well as communicative distance.
Coming into being after absence lets an old report generate a new present event.
A temporal span supplies the future horizon within which the report can signify.
A promising sign from which a coming state is expected turns the past report into an anticipatory marker.

structural_cues: 85:2 places a promised temporal horizon before 85:17 asks whether an earlier collective report has arrived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a promised time, a sign of a coming state, and an arriving report; I infer that the past report can function as that sign. A live alternative is that the promise remains only oath background and does not modify the report's temporality.

changed_reading.before: The question looks backward to a completed military episode.
changed_reading.after: The completed episode arrives carrying a future charge: the report is also an advance sign of an awaited reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated shifts among witness, witnessed object, implicated spectators, and comprehensive knower convert the report into a relay of presence. Its arrival does more than certify facts: it moves the addressee from remote hearer toward a new position in the witnessing chain.

activation_trace.role: Literal arrival supplies the transfer by which witnessed material reaches a new recipient.
Report-bearing speech is the carrier that can extend presence beyond the first scene.
Presence with observation supplies the reciprocal witness-and-witnessed frame for the relay.
Present observation makes spectatorship internal to the violent event rather than neutral background.
Knowledge-bearing declaration supplies an authoritative endpoint that stabilizes the transmitted evidence.

structural_cues: The same root progresses from a balanced witness/witnessed pair at 85:3 to perpetrators witnessing their own action at 85:7 and comprehensive witness at 85:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated witnessing roles and an arriving report; I infer that narration transfers a degree of witnessed presence and ethical implication to its recipient. The weaker alternative is evidentiary confirmation without any transfer of witness-role.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is asked whether secondhand news has reached him.
changed_reading.after: The arriving report recruits the addressee into a layered witness relay, so reception carries implication as well as knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gathered force resolves into a socio-technical apparatus: attached participants, an excavated channel, supplied fuel, fixed surveillance, and enacted work. 'Hosts' therefore names coordination across people, material, posture, and task, not merely soldiers in formation.

activation_trace.role: A gathered mutually supporting force anchors the focus collective that the context decomposes into functions.
Companionship and sustained attachment supply the social bond that keeps participants tied to the apparatus.
A long deep cut supplies engineered terrain as a functional component of collective violence.
Fuel as material input shows that destructive force must be provisioned and maintained.
Sitting for watch or ambush supplies the fixed monitoring posture within the apparatus.
Bringing about an act supplies execution, converting infrastructure and observation into harm.

structural_cues: 85:4-7 sequences an affiliated group, cut ground, fuel, seated monitoring, and a deed directed at a marked population.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies each component and their sequence; I infer functional coordination among them and apply that composite back to the focus plural. The live alternative is that the hosts remain conventional armies while 85:4-7 describes a separate local group.

changed_reading.before: The hosts are military manpower assembled in ranks.
changed_reading.after: The hosts can be any organized machinery of coercion in which affiliation, terrain, fuel, spectatorship, and action mutually sustain one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence places killing beside a victory lexeme that itself can span rescue and death. That double scope destabilizes the hosts' visible metric: survival and coercive success no longer decide who has prevailed, while the acting force becomes the tale.

activation_trace.role: The gathered force supplies the apparent holder of worldly advantage whose metric is being tested.
Becoming a tale reverses active dominance by making the dominant collective an example narrated by others.
Literal killing supplies the outcome that ordinarily appears to settle defeat.
Attainment of good and rescue supplies the explicit positive pole of victory.
The same root's reach into death and perishing keeps bodily loss from functioning as a simple lexical opposite of victory.

structural_cues: Passive killing appears at 85:4, while 85:11 assigns great victory after the believer-and-garden sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies killing, a later positive victory construction, and a victory branch that can include death; I infer a reassignment of the story's victor away from visible survival. An alternative is that victory names only later reward and does not semantically reinterpret the killing.

changed_reading.before: A report of hosts is expected to recount which armed side won.
changed_reading.after: The report interrogates the criterion of winning itself: those killed need not be the defeated, and the force that killed can survive only as a cautionary tale.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's hard-ground and watercourse branches are activated by two opposed channel systems. One cut is engineered as a fire site and fed with fuel; another opens earth to sustained water flowing below. The report of hosts becomes, exploratorily, a disclosure of how power directs matter through terrain toward destruction or life.

activation_trace.role: Rough stony ground anchors the material reading of collective power as terrain.
A watercourse and the clearing or obstruction of its flow supplies the hydraulic mechanism applied to the report.
A long deep incision supplies the first engineered channel.
A fire site or hearth specifies the destructive use assigned to the first channel.
Continuous running and spreading supplies motion through the second channel system.
A river cutting earth with flowing water supplies the life-bearing reversal of the fire-filled cut.

structural_cues: 85:4-5 joins a deep cut to a fire site; 85:11 later joins downward spatial relation to running rivers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both channel complexes plus material branches in the focus; I infer a contrast between destructive and life-bearing direction of flow. The safer alternative leaves these as separate scene descriptions and keeps 'hosts' wholly personal.

changed_reading.before: The report concerns agents who wield military force.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also concerns rival organizations of ground and flow: coercive power turns a cut into a furnace, while the counter-outcome turns channels into sustaining water.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beginning paired with return activates the eventive freshness inside 'report.' Narration does not merely retrieve a closed occurrence; it begins the host-pattern again in cognition so that organized coercion and its reversal can be recognized when they recur.

activation_trace.role: An event coming into being after absence anchors the report's capacity to occur anew.
Freshness and recentness let the retold event retain a present edge rather than becoming inert archive.
Beginning explicitly coupled with return supplies the first half of a repeatable event cycle.
Return after departure and repetition after a beginning supplies recurrence rather than mere recollection.

structural_cues: The adjacent verbs at 85:13 form an explicit begin/return pair shortly before the report-arrival question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies event-freshness and the begin/return pair; I infer that the narrated host-pattern is cognitively re-enacted and made recognizable. The live alternative restricts beginning and return to a separate ontological claim with no narrative effect.

changed_reading.before: The hosts belong to a unique episode safely enclosed in the past.
changed_reading.after: Their report is a recurring pattern-generator: each arrival begins the event again enough for analogous formations and reversals to be recognized.

context_deltas.mechanism: A host normally controls space by flanking, surrounding, and defining an outside. The later behind/other-side ambiguity plus total enclosure reverses that geometry: the formation that appears to contain others is itself contained, and its front/rear distinction cannot produce an escape route.

activation_trace.role: A gathered supporting force supplies the bounded formation whose spatial dominance is reversed.
Becoming a narrated example supplies the temporal containment corresponding to the spatial enclosure.
The side beyond can mean behind, ahead, or otherwise, destabilizing the force's assumed directional escape.
Literal surrounding supplies the outer boundary around those who thought themselves spatially dominant.
Enclosure by overpowering and ruin supplies the consequence of that reversed geometry.

structural_cues: 85:19 places deniers inside an ongoing state, and 85:20 immediately locates an encompassing power beyond them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gathered force in focus and later directional ambiguity plus enclosure around deniers; I infer that the geometry can retrospectively redescribe the hosts. The narrower alternative applies enclosure only to the immediate deniers without modifying the host image.

changed_reading.before: Hosts are the surrounding power that traps others inside their field of action.
changed_reading.after: The report reveals a containment reversal: the surrounding force was always itself enclosed, with no stable rear or front outside the larger grasp.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering and declaring false attempt to interrupt the report's arrival, but recitation, inscription, and guarding create redundant carriers. The question about whether the report has come becomes pointed: the message crosses concealment through voice, durable surface, and retained custody.

activation_trace.role: Arrival anchors the transmission whose route denial tries and fails to close.
Speech arising as report supplies the oral carrier.
Covering supplies the attempted blockage or occlusion of what would otherwise appear.
Attributing a thing or speaker to falsehood supplies the discursive attempt to neutralize the report after arrival.
Reading, reciting, and causing recitation supply repeatable oral retransmission.
A broad writing surface supplies a durable material carrier alongside speech.
Guarding and attentive custody preserve the carriers against loss or suppression.

structural_cues: The post-focus sequence moves from an ongoing state of denial at 85:19 to recited text at 85:21 and guarded inscription at 85:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, falsification, recitation, writing, and guarding; I infer a resilient transmission circuit that specifically bears the hosts' report. The alternative is that the closing preservation language concerns the whole recitation without foregrounding this embedded report.

changed_reading.before: Whether the report arrives appears contingent on ordinary chains of news.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival is resilient and almost confrontational: concealment may resist the report, but oral repetition, inscription, and custody keep reopening its route.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps military gathering onto textual gathering; it remains anchored in the focus's gathered-force branch and in the later packet branches for gathering and guarding. Render it only as a structural counter-formation analogy, not as a claim that the focus noun lexically means scripture.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's gathered host at 85:17 word 4 is carried inside a later recitation that itself gathers and is guarded.

activation_trace.role: A collected force of mutual supporters supplies the organization echoed by the report's medium.
Report-bearing speech embeds the worldly host inside a different kind of organized carrier.
Gathering and assembly make the recitation structurally resemble a counter-collective.
Guarding supplies continuity and cohesion to that textual counter-formation.

changed_reading.before: Only the armies in the narrated world count as an organized force.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the recited and guarded report forms a counter-host whose gathered words outlast and contain the gathered fighters.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the focus root's place-and-district branch rather than its ordinary army branch. Fortification, sovereignty, and the framework of rule keep it contextually live, but downstream prose should call it an administrative-spatial resonance and should not identify any specific geography.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus plural at 85:17 word 4 has a branch for places and military districts, allowing 'hosts' to include territorial organization.

activation_trace.role: Places and military districts supply the administrative-territorial version of the focus collective.
Becoming a tale lets a once-stable jurisdiction be converted into a narrated historical object.
Fortified towers supply the defensive architecture by which territorial force displays permanence.
Sovereignty and rule supply the jurisdictional scale against which lesser districts are relativized.
The sustaining framework of an order, whether standing or toppled, supplies the institutional skeleton of the comparison.

changed_reading.before: The plural points only to mobile field armies.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also evoke fortified jurisdictions and administrative force whose apparent permanence is overturned when they become report.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats narration as material work on the recipient rather than as representation. It remains directly anchored in the focus report-root's blade-and-heart polishing branch and is activated by the packet's fire-and-branding image. Render it as an affective-material analogy: the report may polish or mark attention, not literally burn or sharpen the listener.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus report at 85:17 word 3 has an unusual branch in which polishing a blade extends to cleansing a heart through admonition.

activation_trace.role: Polishing a blade or cleansing a heart supplies the report's transformative work on its recipient.
Arrival brings that abrasive or clarifying action into contact with the addressee.
Kindled fire and the mark made by it supply the contextual image of an event leaving a durable trace.

changed_reading.before: The report merely informs the listener about an external force.
changed_reading.after: As a material-affective analogy, the arriving report also works on the listener, abrading dullness and leaving the narrated violence as a clarifying mark.

strongest_changes: The arriving report became a witness relay that implicates its recipient rather than merely informing one.
The hosts expanded from soldiers into a coordinated apparatus of affiliation, engineered ground, fuel, surveillance, and action.
Visible victory and spatial dominance were reversed: the killers can become the tale, and the surrounding force is itself enclosed.
Denial sharpened rather than blocked arrival because recitation, inscription, and guarding provide multiple carriers.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported several mechanisms at once: temporal arrival, conversion of power into tale, material terrain, and transformative speech. Context did not collapse them; it split them into evidentiary, infrastructural, spatial, hydraulic, recursive, and textual readings, with the strangest branches retained under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The hard-ground and channel model is visibly packet-anchored but remains form-distant from the ordinary plural noun.
The witness relay may transfer ethical implication to the addressee, or it may only certify the report's truth.
The promised future may actively temporalize the hosts' report, or it may remain independent oath framing.
The preserved recitation certainly carries the surrounding discourse, but the degree to which 85:17 foregrounds that carrier remains inferential.
